headline: 97 landslides trigger flooding in Rangamati after heavy rains
summary: Continuous rainfall has submerged low-lying areas and caused nearly 100 landslides across the district.
details: Heavy and continuous rainfall in Rangamati has led to widespread flooding in low-lying areas of the district.
According to local reports, landslides have occurred at 97 different locations across the region, disrupting the landscape and infrastructure.
The sudden surge in water levels has submerged homes and roads, forcing residents to use boats for transportation in several areas.
Local authorities are monitoring the situation as the heavy rains continue to affect the hilly terrain of the Chittagong Hill Tracts.
caption:

headline_marked: Measles outbreak: [[Death toll reaches 747]] as two more children die in 24 hours
headline: Measles outbreak: Death toll reaches 747 as two more children die in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in measles cases, with nearly 1.1 lakh suspected patients since March 15.
details: Two more children died within 24 hours due to measles symptoms, according to a report by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Thursday.
Between Wednesday and Thursday morning, 128 people were confirmed to have measles, while 818 were listed as suspected cases.
Since March 15, the total number of deaths has reached 747, comprising 654 deaths from suspected measles and 93 from confirmed cases.
The scale of the outbreak is significant, with 108,998 suspected and 13,198 confirmed measles patients recorded since mid-March.
Hospitalization data shows that 92,031 patients with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals during this period.
Of those admitted, 88,419 patients have recovered and been discharged from medical facilities.

Hospitalization data shows that 92,031 patients with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals during this period.

Of those admitted, 88,419 patients have recovered and been discharged from medical facilities.
